DeployBot: PROD deploy started by rebecca (release-manager). env=prod, tag=release-3.7.0, commit=8f4a2b1, author=@rebecca. change-window=2026-03-20T21:00Z/22:00Z. rollout plan=canary 5% -> 30% -> 100%. regions=us-west-2,us-east-1. DB migration scheduled (user_account v2.1). release notes: https://go/redwood/release/3.7.0 · CI: https://ci/redwood/12345 :rocket:

alex (eng-lead): ack. I'll watch logs/dashboard. Ping me if canary errors > 0.5% or latency regressions.

sam (sre): spinning up baseline dashboards and synthetic canaries now. posting grafana links in 30s.

nisha (qa): kicking off quick smoke suite against canary hosts. will post pass/fail.

chris_oncall: oncall here. If p50 > 150ms or error spike, pause and notify. noted the rollback tag is release-3.6.9.

DeployBot: Rollout to 5% complete. canary hosts=12. health checks passed. metrics snapshot: p50=42ms, p95=120ms, error_rate=0.0%.

nisha (qa): smoke tests: all green except rerank_flaky.test (intermittent). rerunning once to verify.

alex (eng-lead): thanks. if rerank is non-blocking let's move to 30% in ~2m.

rebecca (release-manager): hold for 30% — DB migration step 2/3 running, ETA ~4m. will announce when done.

rebecca (release-manager): DB migration complete. verified zero downtime on a small shard. proceeding to 30%.

DeployBot: Rollout to 30% complete. will monitor 10m windows and run post-deploy smoke.

sam (sre): noticing a small p95 spike in us-west-2. traces point to a decode kernel path under new quantized model. investigating; impact ~0.3% sessions.

alex (eng-lead): rollback threshold configured: error_rate > 1% sustained for 5m triggers manual rollback. rollback plan ready. @chris_oncall please standby.

chris_oncall: acknowledged. rollback script staged: 
```
kubectl -n prod set image deployment/inference-rs inference=release-3.6.9
./scripts/validate-rollback.sh --probe 30
```
will execute if we hit threshold.

sam (sre): spike leveled off after 3m; p95 returning to baseline. no action required.

DeployBot: Rollout to 100% complete — tag release-3.7.0 promoted to prod. duration=15m. canary checks OK, post-deploy smoke OK. :tada:

rebecca (release-manager): noted. thanks everyone — monitoring for 30m then closing change window. release notes updated with migration details.

alex (eng-lead): nice. watch for any customer-side regressions; will follow up in retro. :shipit:

nisha (qa): all post-deploy tests green. will open one PERF ticket for the p95 blip to track. :thumbsup:

sam (sre): dashboards stable. no regressed SLOs. good job. :eyes:

chris_oncall: rollback not needed. marking oncall TODO done. :heavy_check_mark:
